اختنقن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَنَقْنَ (iḵtanaqna) /ix.ta.naq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
# اِخْتَنِقْنَ (iḵtaniqna) /ix.ta.niq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
